prompt: Review whether Vale has a material causal relationship to critical minerals and structural copper scarcity through Salobo and broader copper growth; accept or reject the edge without treating iron-ore exposure as copper exposure.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Structural copper tightness can transmit into Vale through Salobo execution and broader copper-volume growth, increasing the base-metals contribution and cash flow if project delivery, costs and capital requirements remain controlled.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject the edge if copper remains immaterial to Vale's normalized value, Salobo or other copper projects underdeliver, cost and capital demands absorb the commodity benefit, or iron-ore economics continue to dominate without meaningful diversification.
